name: testGetHeaderMapWhenNull
input: CSVParser created with CSVFormat without headers (e.g., CSVFormat.DEFAULT)
expected: Returns null because headerMap is null (per Javadoc and ternary operator implementation).

name: testGetHeaderMapWhenPresent
input: CSVParser created with a CSVFormat defining headers (e.g., CSVFormat.DEFAULT.withHeader("Col1", "Col2"))
expected: Returns a non-null Map containing column names as keys and 0-based Integer indices as values, iterating in column order (LinkedHashMap).

name: testGetHeaderMapReturnsCopy
input: Calling parser.getHeaderMap() twice or modifying the returned map
expected: Returns a new LinkedHashMap copy on each call so that modifying the returned map does not affect the parser's internal headerMap state.

name: testGetHeaderMapColumnOrder
expected: Returns a Map whose keySet or entrySet iteration order matches the exact insertion/column order ("Z", then "A", then "M").

name: testGetHeaderMapIndicesValues
expected: Returns map entries where "first" maps to 0, "second" maps to 1, and "third" maps to 2.

name: testGetHeaderMapWithAutomaticHeaderDetection
input: CSVParser parsed using CSVFormat.DEFAULT.withHeader() with input "ColA,ColB\nval1,val2"
expected: Returns a map containing "ColA" -> 0 and "ColB" -> 1 after parsing headers from the first record.

name: testGetHeaderMapSingleHeader
input: CSVParser created with a CSVFormat having exactly one header name "SingleCol"
expected: Returns a LinkedHashMap of size 1 containing "SingleCol" -> 0.

name: testGetHeaderMapAfterRecordsParsed
input: CSVParser with headers where several records have already been traversed via nextRecord() or iterator()
expected: Returns the same valid header map copy regardless of the parser's current record traversal progress.

name: testGetHeaderMapAfterParserClosed
input: CSVParser with headers whose close() method has been invoked
expected: Still successfully returns the header map copy, as closing the parser does not clear or invalidate the headerMap field.
